senses.meaning: Doanh thu (tiền thu được trong một thời gian hoặc tại một địa điểm)
examples: The box office takings are up on last week.
Takings rose 45 percent when the new promotion was launched.
Checking the takings at the end of the day is a key part of retail management.

note: Thường dùng số nhiều. Dùng nhiều trong bán lẻ và giải trí.

senses.meaning: Về mặt thương mại; có khả năng sinh lời
examples: The product is not yet commercially available.
It was the first commercially successful AI product on the market.
The drug has not yet been approved for commercially widespread use.

senses.meaning: Sự mua lại, sáp nhập (công ty); vật được mua sắm
examples: The acquisition helped the company enter the US market.
Details of the acquisition were not disclosed to the press.
The museum's latest acquisition is a rare Ming dynasty vase.

note: 'Merger & Acquisition' (M&A) = mua bán và sáp nhập — cụm từ phổ biến trong tài chính.

senses.meaning: Món hời (mua được rẻ); thỏa thuận, giao kèo
examples: The coat was a real bargain at that price.
He drove a hard bargain and got the price down by half.
They struck a bargain: she would work Saturdays in exchange for extra holidays.

senses.meaning: Mặc cả, thương lượng giá cả
examples: They bargained for two hours before reaching a deal.
She bargained the price down from £200 to £150.
Tourists are expected to bargain at the market.

note: 'More than bargained for' = nhiều hơn mong đợi (thường không mong muốn).

senses.meaning: Trao đổi hàng hóa (không dùng tiền)
examples: The settlers bartered furs for food and tools.
I had to barter with the locals when I ran out of money.
They bartered goods at the weekly market.

senses.meaning: Hình thức trao đổi hàng hóa trực tiếp
examples: We used cigarettes as barter in the prisoner-of-war camp.
The economy collapsed to barter when the currency became worthless.
Barter is still used in some traditional economies.

senses.meaning: Thâm hụt, thiếu hụt (chi lớn hơn thu)
examples: The government is struggling to reduce the budget deficit.
The trade balance has been in deficit for the past five years.
A deficit of confidence among investors can stall recovery.

note: 'Budget deficit' = thâm hụt ngân sách. 'Trade deficit' = thâm hụt thương mại. Đối lập với 'surplus' (thặng dư).

senses.meaning: Cổ tức (phần lợi nhuận chia cho cổ đông); lợi ích từ nỗ lực
examples: The company paid a dividend of 30 cents per share.
The dividend had to be paid out of reserves this quarter.
Years of hard training are now paying dividends.

note: 'Pay dividends' (nghĩa bóng) = mang lại kết quả tốt.

senses.meaning: Thanh khoản (khả năng chuyển đổi tài sản thành tiền mặt)
examples: The bank maintained strong liquidity throughout the crisis.
Banks must keep sufficient liquidity to meet depositor demands.
A liquidity crunch forced the firm to sell off assets.

senses.meaning: Phí bảo hiểm; mức giá cao hơn thông thường; ưu đãi/thưởng
examples: Insurance premiums have risen sharply this year.
Customers are willing to pay a premium for high quality.
The shares were sold at a premium above their book value.

note: 'At a premium' = rất khan hiếm và do đó có giá trị cao.

senses.meaning: Thuế quan (thuế đánh lên hàng nhập khẩu); biểu phí dịch vụ
examples: The country imposed high tariffs on imported steel.
A new tariff for low electricity users will also be introduced.
The trading bloc threatened retaliatory tariffs.

senses.meaning: Sinh lời, bắt đầu có lợi nhuận
examples: The company finally turned a profit after three years of losses.
It's difficult for a small business to turn a profit in its first year.
They need to cut costs drastically in order to turn a profit.

senses.meaning: Sự định giá; giá trị được đánh giá
examples: The company's market valuation exceeded two billion dollars.
A property valuation was required before the sale could proceed.
She puts a high valuation on trust between colleagues.

senses.meaning: Sản lượng; lợi suất (trái phiếu/đầu tư)
examples: This variety of wheat produces a higher yield per acre.
Government bond yields have fallen to historic lows.
The farm's yield declined due to the summer drought.

senses.meaning: Mang lại, sinh ra (kết quả, lợi nhuận); nhượng bộ
examples: The investment yielded a ten percent annual return.
He refused to yield to political pressure.
The military promised to yield power to a civilian government.

note: Hai nghĩa động từ: (1) sinh ra sản phẩm/lợi nhuận; (2) nhượng bộ/chịu thua.

senses.meaning: Công ty, hãng (thường là doanh nghiệp nhỏ đến vừa)
examples: She works for a law firm in the city.
The firm went bankrupt after the scandal.
Several consulting firms are bidding for the government contract.

senses.meaning: Cứng, chắc chắn; kiên quyết, dứt khoát
examples: She was firm in her decision not to resign.
He gave a firm handshake.
The mattress is quite firm.

senses.meaning: Hàng hoá (nguyên liệu thô được giao dịch như dầu mỏ, ngũ cốc); thứ có giá trị
examples: Oil is the world's most actively traded commodity.
Clean water is a precious commodity in many parts of the world.
Commodity prices fell sharply on global markets.

note: 'Commodity market' = thị trường hàng hóa (dầu, vàng, nông sản...).

senses.meaning: Tiền đặt cọc; tiền gửi ngân hàng; khoáng sản tích tụ
examples: They'll probably ask you to leave a deposit when you hire the car.
I need to deposit five thousand dollars in my savings account.
Large deposits of iron ore were found in the region.

senses.meaning: Gửi (tiền) vào ngân hàng; đặt cọc; để lại (trầm tích)
examples: She deposited the cheque at the bank.
The river deposits sediment as it reaches the delta.
He deposited his luggage at the hotel before exploring the city.

senses.meaning: Trong nước (kinh tế, thị trường); thuộc về gia đình; ưa mái ấm gia đình
examples: Domestic fuel bills are set to rise again in the autumn.
The policy focuses on boosting domestic demand.
She has always had a very domestic lifestyle.

senses.meaning: Vụ cãi vã gia đình (informal); người giúp việc nhà (dated)
examples: The police were called to sort out a domestic.
He hired two domestics to maintain the large house.
A domestic dispute escalated into a serious incident.

note: 'Domestic violence' = bạo lực gia đình.

senses.meaning: Khoản ghi nợ; tiền bị trừ khỏi tài khoản
examples: The total debits on the account were £2,000 last month.
Settlement is made monthly by direct debit.
Check the debit column in the ledger.

senses.meaning: Ghi nợ; trừ tiền từ tài khoản
examples: The money will be debited from your account each month.
The bank debited his account without prior notice.
Please debit £50 to cover the outstanding balance.

note: Đối lập với 'credit' (ghi có). 'Direct debit' = ủy nhiệm chi tự động.

senses.meaning: Giải ngân, chi trả (tiền từ quỹ hay tổ chức)
examples: The aid will not be disbursed until the conditions are met.
Salaries were disbursed by the paymaster's office every two weeks.
The bank has disbursed over £350 million for the infrastructure project.

note: Formal. 'Disbursement' (n) = khoản giải ngân.

senses.meaning: Cổ phần (trong công ty); mức đặt cược; cọc gỗ/sắt
examples: He holds a 51% stake in the firm.
She has a personal stake in the project's success.
A wooden stake was driven firmly into the ground.

note: 'At stake' = đang bị đe dọa, đặt vào cuộc. 'Stakeholder' = bên liên quan.

senses.meaning: Khấu trừ, trừ đi (thuế, chi phí)
examples: Tax and national insurance are deducted from your wages.
Your employer will deduct the tax automatically.
If you pay for repairs yourself, you can deduct the cost from your rent.

note: 'Tax-deductible' = được khấu trừ thuế.

senses.meaning: Chi tiêu, khoản chi phí (formal)
examples: Public expenditure on education has been cut significantly.
The company kept expenditure under tight control.
Capital expenditure includes spending on equipment and buildings.

senses.meaning: Chi tiêu, tiêu hao (năng lượng, nguồn lực)
examples: Don't expend all your energy on minor tasks.
He expended considerable effort on the project.
They expended their entire budget before the year was out.

note: Formal. Thường dùng 'spend' trong văn nói.

senses.meaning: Khoản vay thế chấp (thường để mua nhà)
examples: They took out a 25-year mortgage to buy their first home.
Monthly mortgage repayments are their biggest expense.
Rising interest rates increase the cost of mortgage repayments.

senses.meaning: Thế chấp (tài sản) để vay tiền; hy sinh tương lai
examples: He mortgaged the house to fund his failing business.
The country has mortgaged its future by taking on so much debt.
She mortgaged her career prospects by accepting the short-term deal.

note: 'Mortgage your future' (nghĩa bóng) = hy sinh tương lai để lấy lợi ích ngắn hạn.

senses.meaning: Thương nhân, lái buôn (thường buôn bán số lượng lớn)
examples: Merchants from across the region traded at the medieval fair.
A wealthy spice merchant built the mansion in the 17th century.
The online merchant shipped goods to over 50 countries.

senses.meaning: Thuộc về tiền tệ, liên quan đến tiền
examples: The central bank made a major monetary policy decision.
Monetary rewards motivate some people more than material incentives.
The monetary value of the painting is enormous.

note: 'Monetary policy' = chính sách tiền tệ (do ngân hàng trung ương quyết định).

senses.meaning: Độc quyền (thị trường); chiếm giữ toàn bộ (sự chú ý, cuộc nói chuyện)
examples: The company monopolised the market for over two decades.
He monopolised the conversation, leaving no room for others.
Regulations exist to prevent any one firm from monopolising the industry.

note: Tiếng Anh Mỹ: 'monopolize'.

senses.meaning: Hàng hoá bán lẻ; đồ lưu niệm chính thức (của nhóm nhạc, đội thể thao)
examples: The official merchandise sold out within hours of the announcement.
The store displayed its merchandise attractively in the window.
Sports teams earn millions from merchandise sales each year.

senses.meaning: Giá trị, ưu điểm; phẩm chất xứng đáng
examples: The application has significant merit and deserves consideration.
Each case should be judged on its own merits.
The proposed system has merit but also serious drawbacks.

senses.meaning: Xứng đáng với, đáng được hưởng
examples: The proposal merits further discussion before a decision is made.
The complaint does not merit a formal investigation.
The issue merits serious attention from policymakers.

note: 'On merit' = dựa trên năng lực, không thiên vị.

senses.meaning: Nhà máy lọc dầu; nhà máy tinh chế (đường, kim loại)
examples: The oil refinery dominates the skyline of the industrial town.
Workers at the refinery went on strike for better pay and conditions.
A sugar refinery was built to process the local crop.

senses.meaning: Doanh thu (thu nhập từ kinh doanh); nguồn thu (ngân sách nhà nước)
examples: The company's annual revenue exceeded one billion dollars.
Tax revenue funds essential public services.
Declining advertising revenue forced the newspaper to cut staff.

note: Phân biệt: 'revenue' = doanh thu tổng; 'profit' = lợi nhuận (sau chi phí).

senses.meaning: Suy thoái kinh tế (thường định nghĩa là 2 quý liên tiếp GDP giảm)
examples: The recession led to widespread job losses.
Governments scrambled to prevent the economy sliding into recession.
The company survived the recession by slashing costs aggressively.

note: Định nghĩa kỹ thuật: 2 quý liên tiếp GDP âm. Phân biệt với 'depression' (suy thoái nghiêm trọng hơn).

senses.meaning: Sự rút tiền/tài sản; mức sụt giảm tối đa từ đỉnh (đầu tư); rút quân
examples: The drawdown of troops began after the peace agreement was signed.
Investors grew nervous about the portfolio's recent drawdown.
A drawdown of foreign reserves was needed to defend the currency.

note: Thuật ngữ tài chính: chênh lệch giữa đỉnh cao nhất và điểm thấp nhất của danh mục đầu tư.

senses.meaning: Thanh lý (công ty/tài sản); tiêu diệt hoàn toàn (informal)
examples: The company was liquidated after failing to pay its debts.
Assets were liquidated to cover outstanding loans.
He was reportedly liquidated by his own organisation.

note: 'Go into liquidation' = bị thanh lý (phá sản).

senses.meaning: Tiền bạc (thường mang sắc thái khinh thường, gắn với lòng tham)
examples: He was lured by the promise of filthy lucre.
True artists don't create for lucre alone.
The scandal revealed how lucre had corrupted the organisation.

note: 'Filthy lucre' (thành ngữ) = tiền bẩn, tiền kiếm được bằng cách xấu.

senses.meaning: Hợp đồng thuê (dài hạn); thời hạn thuê
examples: They signed a five-year lease on the office space.
The lease expires at the end of next year.
You can get a car on lease for as little as £200 a month.

senses.meaning: Cho thuê hoặc thuê (dài hạn có hợp đồng)
examples: He leased the equipment rather than buying it outright.
The company leases its headquarters from a property developer.
She leases her flat to tourists in the summer months.

note: 'Lease' thường dài hạn hơn 'rent'. 'Leasehold' = quyền sử dụng đất thuê; 'freehold' = sở hữu hoàn toàn.

senses.meaning: Sự đánh giá (nhân viên, tài sản, tình hình)
examples: Her annual appraisal was scheduled for Thursday afternoon.
A property appraisal was required before the bank approved the loan.
The manager gave an honest appraisal of the team's performance.

note: 'Performance appraisal' = đánh giá hiệu suất làm việc (nhân sự).

senses.meaning: Cuộc đấu giá
examples: The painting was sold at auction for three million pounds.
Online auctions have become a popular way to buy and sell goods.
Several properties went under the hammer at the auction.

senses.meaning: Bán đấu giá
examples: The old mansion was auctioned to the highest bidder.
The bankrupt firm auctioned its assets to pay creditors.
The domain name was auctioned online.

senses.meaning: Làm tốt hơn, vượt trội (so với đối thủ hoặc chỉ số)
examples: The fund has consistently outperformed the market.
She outperformed all expectations in her first year at the company.
Small firms often outperform large ones in terms of agility.

senses.meaning: Trợ cấp; phụ cấp (thu nhập thêm); tiền tiêu vặt; khoảng dung sai
examples: Do you get a travel allowance for entertaining clients?
My weekly pocket allowance was 50 yuan.
The budget made allowance for unexpected inflation.

note: 'Make allowance for' = tính đến, xem xét đến yếu tố nào đó.

senses.meaning: Sinh lời cao, béo bở
examples: He decided to turn his hobby into a lucrative side business.
She has a lucrative deal with a cosmetics company.
Investment banking is one of the most lucrative careers available.

senses.meaning: Tư nhân hóa (chuyển doanh nghiệp nhà nước thành tư nhân)
examples: The government accelerated its privatisation programme.
The privatisation of state utilities was controversial.
Critics argued that privatisation reduced accountability.

note: Tiếng Anh Mỹ: 'privatization'. Đối lập với 'nationalisation'.

senses.meaning: Chi phí vốn (vốn đầu tư dài hạn vào tài sản cố định)
examples: The company allocated $10 million in CapEx for new manufacturing equipment.
Amazon's CapEx has surged as it builds more data centres to support AWS.
High capex industries like energy require massive upfront investment.

note: Viết tắt của Capital Expenditure. Đối lập với 'OpEx' (chi phí vận hành).

senses.meaning: Chi phí ban đầu bỏ ra; khoản vốn đầu tư
examples: For a relatively small outlay, you can start a home business.
The project would require little financial outlay.
The initial outlay was repaid within two years.

senses.meaning: Chi ra, bỏ ra (tiền)
examples: She outlaid a significant sum to renovate the property.
They outlaid far more than anticipated on compliance costs.
The department outlaid funds on training programmes.

senses.meaning: Sự chuyển nhượng, giải quyết (tài sản, vụ kiện); tính tình, khuynh hướng
examples: The board approved the disposition of the company's non-core assets.
In his will, he made a specific disposition of his property.
She has a cheerful disposition that puts everyone at ease.

note: Hai nghĩa chính: (1) pháp lý/tài chính: sự xử lý tài sản; (2) tính cách: thiên hướng tự nhiên.

senses.meaning: Khấu hao (giá trị giảm dần theo thời gian); sự mất giá tài sản
examples: Annual depreciation is calculated as a percentage of the asset's original value.
The car's rapid depreciation means it's worth half its purchase price after two years.
Straight-line depreciation spreads the cost evenly across the asset's useful life.

note: 'Straight-line depreciation' vs. 'accelerated depreciation' = hai phương pháp khấu hao phổ biến.

senses.meaning: Phá giá đồng tiền (giảm giá trị so với ngoại tệ)
examples: The devaluation of the peso made imports significantly more expensive.
A sharp devaluation boosted the country's export competitiveness overnight.
Investors feared a devaluation following the election result.

senses.meaning: Tham nhũng, hối lộ trong hệ thống; (Anh informal) lao động nặng nhọc; mảnh ghép (y tế/nông nghiệp)
examples: Systemic graft drained billions from public coffers.
Foreign investors were deterred by rampant graft in the system.
After years of hard graft, the company finally took off.

senses.meaning: Ghép (cây, da, mô); làm việc cật lực (informal)
examples: She grafted a new branch onto the apple tree.
Skin was grafted onto the burned areas.
He grafted away at the project for months.

note: Ba nghĩa rất khác nhau: (1) tham nhũng; (2) lao động nặng (informal UK); (3) ghép (y tế/cây).

senses.meaning: Thuế, phí, lệ phí (được chính phủ áp đặt)
examples: A new levy on plastic packaging came into force this year.
The government is considering a windfall levy on energy companies.
The import levy raised prices for consumers significantly.

senses.meaning: Đánh thuế, áp đặt lệ phí
examples: The government levied a windfall tax on oil company profits.
A fine of £500 was levied on the firm for the data breach.
The bloc threatened to levy retaliatory tariffs on imported goods.

senses.meaning: Sự chú ý công chúng; hoạt động quảng bá, tiếp thị
examples: The product launch generated massive media publicity.
Any publicity is good publicity — or so the saying goes.
The scandal brought unwanted publicity to the brand.
